name: True Form (4 Winds Fantasy Gaming)
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 7

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one creature touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

True form removes all magic that alters a creature’s true form or nature. It functions as break enchantment, but can potentially dispel any affect, even those above 5th level. A shapechanger that fails its saving throw will be forced back into its natural shape.
